candidate_windows.window_text:
Our experiment is carried out on two V100 GPU, and all the baseline models adopt the parameters in their original papers. Baselines including NeurJudge, LADAN and C3VG runs 16 epochs in training. BERT and RoBERTa runs 10 epochs in training. The other models runs 100 epochs in training. All the models evaluate once on test set. Tab. 7 shows the number of parameters of all methods. Table 7: The number of parameters of all methods.
Model# of Param
CNN3.5M
LSTM7.6M
Transformer7.9M
DPCNN6.8M
BERT110M
RoBERTa110M
TopJudge9.5M
NeurJudge8.3M
LADAN10.7M
C3VG54.6M
RLJP(CNN)19.5M
RLJP(LSTM)18.7M
RLJP(Transformer)21.9M
